name: ShareRota
shortDescription: UK-operated rota software for church worship, welcome, media, youth and prayer teams, with reminders, swaps and exports.
suitableContexts: Churches scheduling worship, welcome, media, youth and prayer volunteers
Teams moving rota work away from spreadsheets
Leaders needing controlled swap approval and recurring schedules

pricing.summary: ShareRota publishes monthly GBP plans from £9 for up to 10 members to £39 for unlimited members, with a 14-day free trial and no card required until continuing.

startingPrice.qualifier: Basic plan, up to 10 team members

tiers.label: Basic
tiers.detail: Up to 10 team members, basic scheduling, email notifications and PDF/CSV export.

tiers.label: Standard
tiers.detail: Up to 25 members, advanced scheduling, email and SMS notifications, recurring schedules, roles and permissions.

tiers.label: Premium
tiers.detail: Unlimited members, all notification methods, API access, unlimited history, custom branding and priority support.

pricing.trialDetails: All published plans include a 14-day free trial with no card required until continuation.

gdprInformation: The site identifies a privacy-policy and terms route, but their current contents were not available in the reviewed public index. Obtain the current data-processing agreement, hosting region, sub-processor list, retention schedule, deletion process and export format before adding volunteer records.
coreFeatures: SMS notifications on Standard and above
importExport: Additional export formats on Standard and Premium
support: Priority support on the Premium plan
Supplier offers a demo and migration assistance

uk-operator.value: ShareRota identifies itself as a product of Soft Creative Ltd, London, and publishes a London contact location and UK telephone number.

church-workflow.value: Supplier has a church-specific page covering worship, welcome, media, youth and prayer rotas, reminders, swaps and leader oversight.

gbp-pricing.value: Supplier publishes monthly GBP plans at £9, £19 and £39, with a 14-day free trial.

editorial.assessment: ShareRota is a focused scheduling option for churches that need to organise several ministry teams without adopting a broader church-management system. Its published tiers, UK operator statement and church-specific workflow make it a useful specialist comparison. The public research index did not expose the contents of its linked legal pages, so it should be assessed with a current supplier privacy and processing pack before the church stores personal information or sends SMS reminders.
bestFor: Churches wanting a specialist rota tool for several ministry teams
Teams that need controlled swaps, recurring schedules and permissions
Churches that value published GBP pricing and a no-card trial
strengths: Published GBP prices and a 14-day trial
SMS reminders, recurring schedules and permissions on the Standard plan
PDF and CSV exports are published
limitations: It is a general scheduling product rather than a full church-management system
The supplier's linked terms and privacy content require direct review
Hosting, sub-processors, retention, accessibility and exit-data arrangements are not established by the reviewed public material
SMS delivery, payment and any API usage introduce third-party terms to assess

procurementVerdict.problem: Coordinating multiple church volunteer teams without spreadsheet churn
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A church-specific rota workflow with published GBP tiers, reminder channels and controlled swaps
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Trial a real rota with availability, decline, swap, reminder, export and leadership-approval scenarios before importing the whole team
